allow: PowerShell($py = Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $node = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "python: $\(if\($py\){$py.Source}else{'nao'}\)"; "node: $\(if\($node\){$node.Source}else{'nao'}\)")

PowerShell(Get-Partition -DriveLetter H -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; $d = Get-PSDrive H -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "$\($d.DisplayRoot\)"; \(Get-WmiObject Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DeviceID='H:'"\).DriveType)
PowerShell($fb = Get-Command firebase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "firebase: $\(if\($fb\){$fb.Source}else{'nao instalado'}\)"; npm --version)
